newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-CANTERBURY CRUSADERS BEAT WELLINGTON IN SUPER 12.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CANTERBURY CRUSADERS BEAT WELLINGTON IN SUPER 12.

text.p: Canterbury Crusaders beat Wellington Hurricanes 19-17 (halftime 9-3) in a Super 12 rugby union tournament match at Lancaster Park on Friday.
Canterbury Crusaders - Try: James Kerr. Conversion: Daryl Lilley. Penalties: Lilley (4).
Wellington Hurricanes - Tries: Alama Ieremia, Jon Preston. Conversions: Preston (2). Penalty: Preston.
